name: browser-use-playwright
description: The PLAYWRIGHT PROVIDER of the browser-use@1 seam (provider id `playwright`): it drives a real chromium through `playwright-core` - session lifecycle, navigate, the compact SNAPSHOT with SHORT STABLE refs, the full act vocabulary (click/type/fill/select/hover/scroll/press/upload/check/focus/waitFor/back/forward/reload), evaluate, readable extract (text/markdown/html/table/attributes/links/json), FILE screenshots, tabs, waits, downloads/network observation and storage-state reuse. It is LOCATION-AGNOSTIC: WHERE the browser runs is a CONFIG decision - the `browserService.generalService` instance (type + params) is passed through to the general-service@1 seam UNCHANGED (the transport types are the general service's concern, never this plugin's), mirroring the himalaya impl plugin. It reuses the SHARED chromium launcher of this repository (`shared/browser.ts`) instead of forking a second browser stack, so `web-page`, `web-session` and this provider never launch competing browsers. A deployment without a browser fails with the typed `browser-use.no-browser` / `browser-use.endpoint-unreachable` error naming the exact prerequisite - never a silent fallback to a non-browser fetch.

config.description: WHERE the browser runs is a CONFIG decision, never a hardcoded endpoint/image/launch-mode: the plugin is location-agnostic like the himalaya impl plugin. `browserService.generalService` (a general-service@1 instance: type + params) is passed through UNCHANGED to start/probe the browser service, so the transport types are the general service's concern - a new transport type needs no plugin change. `wsEndpoint` / `browserService.endpoint` name the CDP endpoint the provider ATTACHES to.

headless.description: Run the shared chromium without a window. It is a LAUNCH-time setting of the shared process, so a session cannot change it.

viewport.description: Default viewport of a session (a session may override it).

userAgent.description: Default user agent of a session.

proxy.description: Default proxy of a session. `credential` is the NAME of a credentials entry, never a value: it is resolved through the credentials service at launch time.

credential.description: the NAME of the credential holding the proxy password

executablePath.description: A chromium/chrome binary to launch when no endpoint is configured. Absent: playwright resolves its own cache (`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`).

wsEndpoint.description: A REMOTE browser to ATTACH to instead of launching a local chromium: a CDP/websocket endpoint (`ws://browser:3000/`, `http://browser:9222`). When set, the provider connects over CDP and NEVER launches a local process; an endpoint that does not answer fails with the typed `browser-use.endpoint-unreachable` naming it - no silent local launch, no silent HTTP fetch. `cdpEndpoint` is accepted as an alias.

cdpEndpoint.description: Alias of `wsEndpoint`, for a caller that thinks in CDP terms.

browserService.description: The SEPARATE browser service (its own image) this provider ATTACHES to, e.g. the stack `browser` service. `endpoint` is where it answers (`http://browser:9222`); `image` is named in answers/errors; `generalService` is the general-service@1 instance (type + params) used to START/probe that service when the endpoint does not answer yet - the instance is passed through UNCHANGED: the transport types are the general service's concern, this provider never hard-wires docker or ssh.

endpoint.description: Where the browser service answers: `http://host:port` or a `ws(s)://` CDP URL, e.g. `http://browser:9222`.

image.description: The image the service runs (named in the answers/errors), e.g. `ghcr.io/nexuslbs/workstation-plugins/browser:0.0.3`.

generalService.description: The general-service@1 instance (`type` + `params`) that probes/starts the service, passed through unchanged.

start.description: The command run THROUGH the instance when the endpoint does not answer (start it).

probe.description: A command run through the instance as a liveness/diagnostic proof (reported when the start fails).

startTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the endpoint after `start`.

browserArgs.description: Extra chromium argv, handed over verbatim (argv, never a shell string).

storageStateDir.description: Where the per-session storage-state files live (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use/state`), the SAME convention `web-session` uses.

screenshotDir.description: Where a screenshot without an explicit path is written (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use`; a relative value is resolved against the CWD). This provider OWNS the file it writes, so this value WINS over the host bound `plugins.browser-use-impl.screenshotDir`, and the answered path is always ABSOLUTE.

downloadDir.description: Where a session's downloads are saved (default `<storageStateDir>/downloads`).

launchTimeoutMs.description: Budget of the shared chromium launch.

defaultSession.description: The session id a call uses when it names none.

observeLimit.description: How many requests/downloads the per-session observer keeps.

sessionTtlSeconds.description: Idle seconds after which a session's context is closed (0 = never).
